summary: Attempt 003 fixes the three required_changes from attempt 002 review: (1) ruff format on tests/test_ingestion_runner.py is now clean (73 files formatted, no regressions); (2) manifest_checksum rejection is implemented in planner._validate_warm_checkpoint — RangePlannerInputs gains an expected_manifest_checksum field and the runner computes the expected checksum from the current capability/budget snapshots and passes it to the planner, which raises CheckpointMismatchError on mismatch; the runner catches the error and halts with halt_reason='checkpoint_manifest_drift', complete=False, no advance; test_checkpoint_rejection_on_mismatched_manifest_checksum now asserts the rejection path; (3) qualified_end_block_hash validation is implemented in IngestionRunner.run via a new _verify_qualified_end_block_hash helper that re-fetches the canonical block hash at qualified_end_block from every registered endpoint's get_block_hash_for_pin and halts with 'checkpoint_block_hash_drift' (or 'checkpoint_block_hash_unverified' when no client returns a hash) when the stored hash disagrees; two new tests cover the mismatch rejection path and the matching-hash acceptance path.
